exposure: Robert's uterus (asymmetric septate uterus with hematometra)
Resection of uterine septum and unification of hemi-cavities (metroplasty)
cohort: A single 19-year-old female patient diagnosed with Robert's uterus and worsening dysmenorrhea.
finding: A successful pregnancy and live birth can be achieved in patients with Robert's uterus after surgical correction and assisted reproductive technology.
mod_finding: The patient delivered by caesarean section at term.
followup_time: At least 7 years from surgery to delivery
